title: Az első végződések
summary: Hungarian builds meaning by adding endings to words. Three you have already met: -hat/-het, -an/-en and -ul/-ül.

sections.text: Instead of extra words, Hungarian often adds an **ending** (végződés). Most endings have a back and a front version, chosen by vowel harmony.
Notice that *lassú* drops its long ú before an ending. Small changes like this are common; just learn the forms as you meet them.
